images.subject: A deuterium synthesis plant built around one cluster of giant spherical pressure tanks. On the left side of the frame, on the platform, stands a second large and clearly separate block: a second giant spherical pressure tank with its own supports, linked to the first by thick pipes.
images.detail: Thick insulated pipes run from the tanks down into the sea.
images.site: It stands on a broad platform at the foot of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff that plunges straight into a dark slate-grey sea with heavy swell, on a lifeless alien planet of bare rock.
